This maize piece is very small, and I do not like to spend scarce cash on a full bag when my plot takes only a little. I will plant the seed I know, and I will use manure from home because that is what I can manage on my own land. I am an old woman, so I will keep this plot with family work and not bring hired people unless there is no other way, and on this small piece I will not do that.
